{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed['revenue_float'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = completed[completed['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))
print("Order IDs of QA orders:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
real_completed = completed[completed['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue = real_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

print("Number of real completed orders (after removing QA):", len(real_completed))
print("Mean revenue (USD):", mean_revenue)"}
